text: The purpose of this report is to seek further instruction in relation to a development application for a site that contains several heritage resources, and a related ongoing appeal at the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal. An Local Planning Appeal Tribunal prehearing conference has been scheduled for August 1, 2018.

The Toronto Preservation Board recommends that: 1. City Council adopt the confidential recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to this report. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the instructions in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices "A" through "E", if adopted by City Council, with the balance of the Confidential Attachment 1 to remain confidential as it contains advice which is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
